apps.localizedDescription: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on iPhone and iPad - no jailbreak. Madeira bundles FEX-Emu, Wine, and DXMT, and puts your GOG, Epic Games, EA app, and itch.io libraries in one place: sign in, download, and play. Requires iOS 18 or later. The IPA links straight to the official willfaust/Madeira GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds a GOG section (sign in, library, downloads, Galaxy achievements and stats), an EA app section (library and downloads), and itch.io support. Epic Games downloads and cloud saves now work together. New store tabs when more than one store is enabled.
